gates.requiredScope: The exact intended Feature-031 candidate has no whitespace, missing-file, placeholder, generated-output, protected-source, dependency, package, external-checkout, or unintended Wave implementation defect.
gates.rationale: The staged candidate, including every new evidence file, is the delivery unit.

gates.requiredScope: Feature-024, Feature-028, Feature-029, Feature-030, and Feature-031 evidence validators pass together on the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: Feature 031 composes all accepted conformance evidence and adds a test-only closure validator.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A closure dataset, validator, accepted input, or proof path changes.

gates.requiredScope: The full TuiVision solution passes in Release configuration.
gates.rationale: Wave-5 eligibility is a repository-wide release decision.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any test, project, status, or acceptance input changes.

gates.requiredScope: Core, Controls, Serialization, Compatibility, and Drivers.Console each retain at least 70 percent line coverage.
gates.rationale: The repository Constitution forbids merge below the five-assembly coverage gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Tests, coverage configuration, or gate assemblies change.

gates.requiredScope: Generated documentation builds without warning or error for learner-facing closure, status, and ordering changes.
gates.rationale: Feature 031 changes learner-facing evidence and release status.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Documentation, navigation, or DocFX configuration changes.

gates.requiredScope: The generated DocFX site passes the Playwright and Axe accessibility smoke path.
gates.rationale: DocFX completion requires the matching accessibility proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Generated pages, navigation, templates, or A11Y tests change.

gates.requiredScope: Secrets, dependencies, generated output, protected roots, external checkouts, evidence hashes, and evidence-only scope remain clean.
gates.rationale: A false or contaminated closure could release Wave 5 incorrectly.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Candidate paths, dependencies, external inputs, or security workflow change.

gates.requiredScope: All maintained agent, Pflichtenheft, processing-order, gate, and evidence surfaces agree on active Feature 031 and the causal Wave transition.
gates.rationale: Divergent ordering can start Wave 5 before closure.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Agent guidance, Pflichtenheft, processing order, or Wave marker changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed head executes the repository Release test body on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows.
gates.rationale: Cross-platform repository readiness is part of the Wave-5 gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Workflow matrix, runner, or test command changes.

gates.requiredScope: The Feature-031 run state validates at logical boundaries and completes with accurate artefact hashes, tasks, authority, stage, status, and next action.
gates.rationale: A stale or invalid state makes autonomous delivery and closeout untrustworthy.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Run state, task file, accepted artifacts, authority, or lifecycle changes.

gates.requiredScope: Review threads, comments, reviewer availability, and Human Approval are verified directly through provider APIs.
gates.rationale: The command gate schema validates executable technical proof; review state is a separate provider fact.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A provider-neutral review-evidence command contract is adopted.

gates.requiredScope: Wave eligibility and terminal merge/synchronization facts exist only after the reviewed feature merge and are verified through the evidence-only closeout plus provider facts.
gates.rationale: A command executed on the feature head cannot prove its own future merge.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The repository adopts an external immutable delivery ledger that can replace the causal closeout.
